JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL
GROUP BY o.order_status;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  DAYNAME(DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS purchase_weekday,
  COUNT(*) AS review_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS five_star_count,
  (1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*) AS five_star_ratio
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01'
GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(o.order_purchase_timestamp), DAYNAME(DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp))
ORDER BY five_star_ratio DESC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  r.review_score,
  COUNT(*) AS review_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carrier_date_present_count,
  (1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*) AS carrier_date_present_ratio
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_approved_at IS NULL
GROUP BY r.review_score
ORDER BY r.review_score;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score,
  AVG(DATEDIFF(o.order_approved_at, o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_days_purchase_to_approval,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
  AND (r.review_comment_title REGEXP '[0-9]' OR r.review_comment_message REGEXP '[0-9]')
  AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS review_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(r.review_answer_timestamp, r.review_creation_date) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answered_next_day_count,
  (1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(r.review_answer_timestamp, r.review_creation_date) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*) AS answered_next_day_ratio
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE r.review_creation_date >= '2018-01-01'
  AND r.review_creation_date < '2018-04-01'
  AND o.order_status = 'delivered';

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.order_status,
  r.review_score,
  DATEDIFF(r.review_creation_date, o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS days_purchase_to_survey
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01'
ORDER BY DATEDIFF(r.review_creation_date, o.order_purchase_timestamp) DESC
LIMIT 5;
